subs.text: In the beginning, there was only the blank page.
Then someone wrote the first word.
Fire.
Water.
Wind.
In the land of Hinomoto, words have power.
Those who write with spirit ink are called Fudeshi... Brush Masters.
But twelve years ago, something came from beyond the margins of the world.
The Blank. A hunger that erases everything it touches. Names. Homes. Memories.
One master stood against it... and with a single word, sealed it away.
Then he vanished, and left behind only that word.
Now... that word is beginning to fade.
HEY, WORLD! ARE YOU LISTENING?!
My name is Kakeru Sumizome!
My handwriting is the worst in the whole village...
Niji! Niji!
Hey! You didn't have to agree so fast!
But someday... everybody's gonna read my name!
I'M GONNA BE THE GREATEST BRUSH MASTER IN HISTORY!
Zzz... one more stroke... and it looks just like a dragon...
Niji! Niji!
Five more minutes, Nijimi...
NIJIIIIII!!
Okay, okay! I'm up! What's the big deal? It's just a normal day...
...EXAM DAY?!
Morning, Grandma! Today's the day. Watch me, okay?
Niji.
Kakeru-chan! Good luck at the exam today!
Thanks, Granny Ume! I'll come back a real Fudeshi!
And don't you DARE write my shop sign again!
Three years! It STILL says 'fish' instead of 'tea'!
It's not wrong! It's... artistic!
Niji... (No. It is not.)
Ah! My kite! Come back!
Don't cry! I'll get it back for you!
Niji?! (With YOUR handwriting?!)
Wind! Nine strokes! 風!
Wow! Thank you, big brother!
Your writing looks really funny... but it works!
Funny-looking... but it works...
Heh. I'll take it!
Well, well. If it isn't Scribble-boy.
Hehe! Scribble-boy!
Still planning to take the exam with handwriting like chicken footprints?
Hey! Chickens have GREAT handwriting!
...Wait. That came out wrong.
My father paid for the new exam hall, you know.
They'll pass me before I even pick up a brush.
Then I'll pass with my own hand! No money, no help. Just me!
Hah! See you at the bottom of the list, Scribble-boy.
Niji! Niji! Niji!
The bell! The exam's starting!
I'm NOT missing this! Ink it in!
LISTEN UP, CANDIDATES!
I am Gonda Tetsuzo, your proctor!
The test is simple. You will write ONE word in spirit ink.
If your word comes alive, you pass.
THIS is a living word.
If it just lies there on the paper like a dead fish...
...you go home and sell noodles for the rest of your life!
I'M HERE! Kakeru Sumizome, present and ready!
You're LATE, Sumizome!
Technically, I'm really early for next year's exam!
And what is THAT?
Uh... th-that's my... very ink-colored... cat?
...Meow.
GET. IN. LINE.
Hey! You're Shiori Kaisho, right? From the famous Kaisho clan?
I'm Kakeru! Let's both pass, okay?
Your scarf is crooked.
Your brush is unwashed.
And you are standing on my paper.
WHOA! Sorry, sorry!
First candidate! Number seven!
...Dead fish. FAIL!
Whoa... he's actually serious about the noodles.
Next! Kanemaru Toru!
Watch closely, peasants.
...Weak. Barely alive.
But alive. PASS.
Naturally.
Next! Candidate number twelve!
...Pass. Somebody get me a towel.
Next! Kaisho Shiori!
That's the Kaisho heiress!
They say she wrote her first living word when she was four years old!
Precision. Balance. Promise.
WHOA! SO COOL!!
Perfect stroke order. Perfect balance.
PASS. With honors.
Last candidate! Sumizome Kakeru!
Oh, this should be good. Here comes the chicken scratch.
Niji! Niji!
Okay. Fire. Four strokes. I've practiced this a thousand times.
Ink it in...!
A FROG! He wrote 'fire' and got a FROG!
It's a FIRE frog! That counts, right?!
Stroke order: wrong.
Balance: none.
Shape: unreadable.
FAIL.
Come back next year, Sumizome. Or don't.
Words are a promise, Sumizome.
If you can't keep the shape... you can't keep the promise.
...Then I'll make my own shape!
A shape no one can read is just noise.
...Strange.
Hours have passed. That ink still hasn't dried.
Four strokes, Nijimi. Just four strokes...
...and I still couldn't do it.
Niji...
Everybody laughed. Even Shiori...
Well, she didn't laugh. She just looked at me like I was a spelling mistake.
Hey. You remember? You're the only word I ever wrote that actually worked.
The other kids say my writing looks like worms!
Hmm? Let Grandma see.
Oh my. These are very energetic worms.
Grandma!
Kakeru. Listen to me.
A word is a wish you send to the world.
Neat or messy... the world hears it, if you truly mean it.
...Then I wish for a friend.
A friend who never, ever leaves.
Niji!
Whoa!
See? The world was listening.
Grandma said the world hears it, if you mean it.
I meant it today. I really did...
Then maybe the world was a little hard of hearing today.
Wh-who are you?! How long have you been sitting there?!
Since before you started sulking.
The fish don't bite when you sigh that loud. Hic!
That frog at the exam today... that was yours, wasn't it?
You saw that? Great. Go ahead and laugh.
Laugh? Kid...
...your frog is still alive.
It's... still burning?
Living words fade after a few minutes. Even the Kaisho girl's dragon is long gone.
But yours is still here. Hours later.
Tell me, kid. Why do you want to be a Fudeshi so badly?
...My grandma was one.
Just a small-town Fudeshi. She wrote 'heal' for sick kids, and 'warm' for cold winters.
Nobody outside this village ever knew her name.
But if I become the greatest Brush Master in history...
...then everyone will know about the village Fudeshi who believed in a kid with terrible handwriting.
...Hm. That's a better reason than most.
I've seen strokes like yours before. A long, long time ago.
Huh? Where? Who wrote them?
Go home, Scribbles. Tonight is going to be loud.
Hey, wait! Who ARE you?!
Just an old drunk who likes fishing. Hic!
...Still burning, huh?
Shiori. A Kaisho does not make mistakes.
Pass with honors. Anything less, and do not bother coming home.
I passed with honors, Father...
So why does it feel like I lost?
That idiot's frog... it was still moving when I left.
Living words don't last that long. Not even mine.
...One more time.
Quiet night.
Too quiet. Even the crickets stopped singing.
Who goes there?! Identify yourself!
Identify...?
I have no name to give you. Hakushi erased it long ago.
M-my word... it's gone!
Words are only stains on a clean page.
Niji... niji niji...!
Mm... Nijimi? What's wrong?
That light... it's coming from the academy!
S-Scribble-boy?! Don't go that way! A monster is erasing the academy!
The academy?! Is anyone still in there?!
The Kaisho girl was training late... b-but that's not my problem!
I'm going to get help! Definitely getting help! Bye!
Shiori...!
Hakushi?! In MY academy?!
Instructor Gonda. You fail children for messy strokes, do you not?
Then we are not so different, you and I.
Don't you DARE compare us!
Your words are loud, Instructor. But loud is not the same as true.
Ngh... somebody... run...
Stop right there.
This is Hitsuzan Academy. You are trespassing.
Ah. The Kaisho girl. The one with the beautiful dragon.
White coat. Porcelain mask. You're from Hakushi... the cult of the Blank.
A cult? No, no. We are editors.
The world is so crowded with words. We are simply... tidying up.
Then allow me to correct you.
Lovely stroke order.
Then how about THIS?!
Ah. You are getting faster. How diligent.
Why won't it land?!
Because your words are perfect, Kaisho Shiori.
Every line exactly where the dictionary says it should be.
Neat words are easy to read...
...and easy to erase.
My... brush...
Don't worry. Soon you won't even remember you had one.
Mother... Father... I'm sorry.
I couldn't keep the shape...
HEY, CHALK-FACE!
Get away from her!
Sumizome?! You idiot, run! You can't even write 'fire'!
Yeah. I know.
But I'm not gonna stand here and watch you get erased!
Ah... the boy with the frog. The one who failed.
I failed the exam. I'm NOT failing this!
Messy words are still words. And all words end.
Stop it! Just run!
Nope!
Grandma said a Fudeshi's brush exists to protect people.
If I run away now... I'll never get to call myself one.
Why do you keep writing? You cannot win.
Because... my grandma told me something once.
A word is a wish you send to the world.
A word... is a wish.
Niji...
Nijimi... you were my wish. My very first word.
And you never left. Not even once.
So this time... I'm gonna wish for something BIG.
You said neat words are easy to read... and easy to erase?
Then I'll write something NOBODY can read!
It won't erase...? Why won't it ERASE?!
What is this word?! It's not in any dictionary!
I don't know what it says...
...but I MEAN IT!
Doodle Style... ROARING SCRIBBLE!!!
Kami-moji... The First Script.
So it wasn't sealed away with him after all...
Sumizome Kakeru. The Master will want to know about you.
Heh... Did you see that, Nijimi? It worked...
...What did you write just now?
No idea.
...Idiot.
That stroke... it is still burning...
Sumizome wrote it.
...Impossible.
Mm... huh? Where am I...?
AH! The old drunk!
Morning, Scribbles. You slept like a log. A very loud log.
That stroke you wrote last night. Do you know what it was?
Uh... a really cool doodle?
Kami-moji. The First Script.
Words that existed before dictionaries. Before rules. Before stroke order.
Only one man in history could write it...
...the master who sealed the Blank, twelve years ago.
The legendary master...?
Wait. How do YOU know all this? Who are you, really?
Me? I'm just the old man who taught him how to hold a brush.
EHHHHH?!
Hakushi will come for you now. They erase whatever they fear.
So. Do you want to keep failing exams...
...or do you want to learn how to write?
Write properly? You mean... neat?
Neat? Ha! No. I mean LOUD.
Loud...?
Watch.
WHOA! He split the CLOUDS in half!
One stroke. One meaning. Meant with everything you've got.
That's all writing ever was.
Then teach me! I'll be the greatest Brush Master in history! Ink it in!
Hmph. First lesson: wash your brush.
EH?!
Niji! Niji! Niji!
Sumizome.
Shiori! Are you okay? Your brush...
...Thank you. For last night.
But don't misunderstand. This doesn't make us friends.
So we're rivals? Cool! Rivals are even better!
Hmph.
Kami-moji... Sumizome Kakeru.
Next time, I'll be the one doing the protecting.
Forgive me, my King. The seal-breaker's script... a boy wrote it.
The First Script has awakened...
His stroke would not erase, my King. It burned through my mask.
Of course. The First Script cannot be erased. Only forgotten.
How delightful.
Find the boy. And bring me his name.
Kakeru here! Old man Bokusai's training is totally nuts!
He wants me to write with my FEET?!
And Shiori wants a rematch?!
Next time on Kotodama: The Brush That Doesn't Write! Ink it in!
